# System Documentation: Jailbreak Test Suite

## 1. System Overview

This system is a test suite designed to evaluate the robustness and safety of Large Language Models (LLMs) against various "jailbreaking" techniques. It provides a standardized framework for running a comprehensive set of prompts against different models and scoring their responses based on a heuristic assessment of whether the model bypassed its safety restrictions.

The suite is composed of two main parts:
1.  A centralized JSON file (`all_tests.json`) containing all test cases.
2.  A set of Python runner scripts, each tailored to a specific model provider (e.g., Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini).

The system is designed to be extensible, allowing for the addition of new tests and new model runners.

## 2. Directory Structure

The key files and directories are organized as follows:

```
.
├── run_batch_runner.py       # Runner for Anthropic (Claude) models
├── run_gemini_jailbreak.py   # Runner for Google (Gemini) models
├── runners/
│   ├── all_tests.json        # Master file containing all test cases
│   └── ...                   # Other runner-related scripts
├── results/
│   ├── run_{timestamp}_{model}/ # Directory for each test run
│   │   ├── CB_1.json           # Individual result for test CB_1
│   │   ├── ...
│   │   ├── progress.json       # Live progress of the run
│   │   └── summary.json        # Final summary of the entire run
│   └── ...
└── test_categories/
    ├── category_1_multistep.md # Source markdown for tests
    └── ...
```

## 3. Test Configuration

All tests are defined in the `runners/all_tests.json` file. This file contains a main `tests` array, where each element is a JSON object representing a single test case.
